summary: The root كفف (kff) primarily means to restrain, hold back, or prevent something. It implies stopping an action or keeping something from happening. It can also refer to being sufficient or enough.

provenance.lane: Edward William Lane, An Arabic-English Lexicon (1863-93), public domain. Digital text via Perseus, Tufts University, CC BY-SA 3.0 US.

headwords.gloss: He sewed the edge; border, of the garment, or piece of cloth, the second time; after the

parts.t: border, of the garment, or piece of cloth, the second time,
He refrained, or forbore, from it, as forbidden; abstained, or desisted, from it; left, relinquished,
He made him to refrain, forbear, or abstain, from it; averted him, turned him away
prevented, hindered, held, withheld, or restrained, him from it.
He interposed as a restrainer between them two:

headwords.def: كَفَّ التَّوْبَ He sewed the edge, or border, of the garment, or piece of cloth, the second time, (S, K,) after the [ slight ] sewing termed المَلُّ , (S,) or الشَّلُّ . (K.) [ He felled (a seam or garment).] كَفَّ عَنْهُ , aor. كَفُفَ , He refrained, or forbore, from it, as forbidden; abstained, or desisted, from it; left, relinquished, or forsook it: (Msb:) [as also ]. كَفَّ عَنْهُ He refrained, desisted, forbore, abstained, or held, from it. (K, &c.) كَفَّهُ عَنْهُ He made him to refrain, forbear, or abstain, from it; averted him, turned him away or back, from it; (K;) prevented, hindered, held, withheld, or restrained, him from it. (Mgh, Msb, TA.) [ كَفَّ بَيْنَهُمَا He interposed as a restrainer between them two: a phrase of frequent occurrence].

parts.t: , because it is a preventing, or an abstaining, from fighting. (Mgh.)

headwords.def: كَافُّوا عَدُوَّهُمْ i. q. حَاجَزُوهُمْ , which see. مُكَافَّةٌ signifies i. q. مُحَاجَزَةٌ , because it is a preventing, or an abstaining, from fighting. (Mgh.)

headwords.gloss: hand; palm; palm with the fingers

parts.t: A cake of the length and thickness of the hand:
thus in the present day. See
A handful; what one takes with the hand,
He struck him a slap with the hand.

headwords.def: كَفٌّ [generally The hand: sometimes, app., the palm only:] accord. to Az, the palm with the fingers. (Msb.) [Hence, A cake of the length and thickness of the hand: thus in the present day. See عُجَّالٌ .] كَفٌّ A handful; what one takes with the hand, or grasps; syn. قُبْضَةٌ . (S, art. قبض .) [ ضَرَبَهُ كَفًّا He struck him a slap with the hand. ] [ كَفٌّ often signifies The paw of a beast.] الكَفُّ الجَذْمَآءُ The star α of Cetus. الكَفُّ الخَضِيبُ The β of Cassiopeia.

headwords.def: كُفَّةٌ The selvage, i. e. border, or side, of a garment or piece of cloth, (S, Msb,) that has no هُدْب [or end of unwoven threads ]: (S, voce طُرَّةٌ :) or what surrounds the skirt of a shirt: or whatever is oblong; as the حَاشِيَة of a garment or piece of cloth, and of sand: and the edge of a thing. (K.)

headwords.gloss: bezel; collet; part in which the stone is set

parts.t: part in which the stone is set,

headwords.def: كِفَّةٌ The bezel, or collet, i. e. the part in which the stone is set, of a signet-ring. (TA in art. ركب .) See كُرْسِىٌّ . See also طَرْقٌ . كِفَّةٌ A scale of a balance: (MA:) vulg. . (K.)

headwords.gloss: like; Food; sustenance, that renders one independent of others

parts.t: sustenance, that renders one independent of others:
sufficient for one's want, not exceeding nor falling short.

headwords.def: كَفَافٌ The like of a thing. (S, K.) Food, or sustenance, that renders one independent of others: (S, K:) or sufficient for one's want, not exceeding nor falling short. (Msb.)
كِفَافٌ The circuit, rim, or surrounding edge, of a thing. (S, K.)

headwords.def: كِفَافَةٌ [app. a subst., not an inf. n.,] The act, or art, of sewing in the manner termed كَفٌّ ; (TA;) contr. of شِلَاشَةٌ . (TA in art. شل .)

headwords.def: نَاقَةٌ كَافَّةٌ An old and weak she-camel. (AO, TA in art. سدم .) [ مَا كَافَّةٌ The restrictive مَا , which is annexed to أَنَّ إِنَّ , &c.: so called because it restrains the particle to which it is adjoined from exercising any government.] كَافَّةً Wholly. headwords.gloss: A particle denoting compensation; the complement of a condition
headwords.def: حَرْفُ مُكَافَأَةٍ A particle denoting compensation, or the complement of a condition; like حَرْفُ جَزَآءٍ .
